methods.source: Only cached registry records: data/fixtures/ctgov/NCT*.json and data/fixtures/peers/registry/NCT*.json (every ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 study for query.cond=COPD with AREA[Phase]PHASE3); .meta.json files are excluded. When an NCT is in both, the ctgov file is used. Counts describe the cached registry record, not edits to the saved design.
methods.cohort: Exact normalized phase and condition_group of the saved design. Exclude its registry_id; count each other registry_id once. Unknown phase or condition has no peers.
methods.phase: Normalize phase labels and Roman numerals; retain combined phases (Phase 2/3 is PHASE2/PHASE3, never PHASE3 alone).
methods.condition_group: Use the first non-empty listed condition; normalize Unicode, case, punctuation and whitespace. Map COPD, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease, Pulmonary Disease, Chronic Obstructive and their combined COPD spellings to copd; DME and Diabetic Macular Edema to diabetic_macular_edema. No other condition (emphysema, pulmonary hypertension, heart failure, ...) is merged into copd. Do not infer disease from titles, eligibility text or sponsor.
methods.outcomes: Count entries in primaryOutcomes; all outcomes = primaryOutcomes + secondaryOutcomes + otherOutcomes. A missing outcomesModule is unknown.
methods.eligibility: Split eligibilityCriteria with splitlines(), trim each line, discard empty lines. Exclude section headings beginning with optional 'Key' then 'Inclusion Criteria' or 'Exclusion Criteria'; headings set the section, including repeated randomization sections. Count every remaining non-empty line once in that section. Sub-bullets, continuation lines and internal subheadings count separately. Total includes unsectioned lines. A missing section is unknown, not zero. These are text-line counts, not adjudicated criteria.
methods.locations: Sites = number of location entries, without deduplication. Countries = distinct non-empty trimmed, case-folded location country strings. Missing locations are unknown; countries are unknown if any listed location lacks a country.
methods.enrollment: enrollment_reported is enrollmentInfo.count with its enrollment_type. enrollment_target uses only ESTIMATED counts. ACTUAL counts are displayed separately and never treated as planned targets; missing targets are null.
methods.comparison: More/fewer/same compares the record count to the median of reported peer counts, even in a small cohort. cohort_n is all matched peers; available_n is peers reporting this metric. This is a descriptive comparison, not a quality score.
methods.percentile: 100 * (peers below + 0.5 * peers tied) / available_n. Return null and insufficient_peers if cohort_n < 5 or available_n < 5; never interpret as quality.
